plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Atomic, hunk-level git commits — one commit per intent, with message guards that follow your repository's existing language and conventions

plugins.name: pull
plugins.description: Bulk git pull across every repo under the working directory plus external workspaces from settings — parallel fetch, rebase-pull of outdated repos, and submodule update reporting

plugins.name: changelog
plugins.description: Analyze commits (including submodules) since the last release tag and output a CHANGELOG grouped by user impact — chat-only, no file written
